Class SynqAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.quark.synq.SynqAutoConfiguration
@Configuration public class SynqAutoConfiguration extends Object

Auto-configures Synq for a Spring application.

A SyncUserResolver bean must be exposed by the application.

Configuration properties:
  • quark.synq.scaling.enabled: Enables a REDIS-based event system for multi-instance applications. The default event implementation is for single-instance applications.
  • quark.synq.scaling.stream-key: For quark.synq.scaling.enabled=true only. The REDIS stream key to use for synq events.
  • quark.synq.max-events: The maximum number of events to keep in the event cache. Affects the ability of clients to be updated after a temporary connection loss without needing to completely repopulate the data set.
